subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should OpenClaw repair the bundled Himalaya skill docs now, or let the active bundled-skill trimming path remove or externalize Himalaya first?
rationale: The stale docs are real current and shipped surface, but VISION.md and the open protected trimming PR point toward moving optional skills out of bundled core, so automation should not choose that product boundary.

options.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product gate, then close this if Himalaya leaves core or patch docs if it remains bundled.

options.title: Patch Bundled Docs Now
options.body: Keep Himalaya bundled for now and land a focused docs repair with verified Himalaya version scope and the current upstream save-copy reference.

options.title: Move To External Skill Package
options.body: Ask contributors to maintain Himalaya as a ClawHub skill or bundle and close the core docs issue once users have a clear external package path.

recommendation.title: Resolve Through Skill Trimming
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132 or its successor as the product gate, then close this if Himalaya leaves core or patch docs if it remains bundled.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc shaped the active bundled-skill trimming split and validation path that now blocks this docs cleanup decision.
